 Home › Deals › M5 MacBook Air with 1TB drops to $1,399 on Amazon, $200 off in every color M5 MacBook Air with 1TB drops to $1,399 on Amazon, $200 off in every color
 Shane Watson 
 2 minute read 
 Oct 30th, 2026 6:50 AM EET | Deals 
 Amazon has the 13-inch MacBook Air with M5 and 1TB for $1,399 , $200 below its $1,599 list price. The 24GB model with 1TB is $1,599 , also $200 off. Every color is on sale.
 We checked every price and ship date below on Amazon on October 30, 2026. Amazon.com sells and ships all of them, and they arrive by November 3.
 Every 13-inch M5 MacBook Air deal on Amazon, from $1,099 to $1,599
 Model Colors at this price Amazon price List price You save 
 8-core GPU, 16GB, 512GB Silver, starlight $1,099 $1,299 $200 
 8-core GPU, 16GB, 512GB Midnight, sky blue $1,149 $1,299 $150 
 10-core GPU, 16GB, 1TB All four colors $1,399 $1,599 $200 
 10-core GPU, 24GB, 1TB All four colors $1,599 $1,799 $200 
 The 1TB model at $1,399 also gets you the faster 10-core GPU
 This is the part most buyers miss. The base 13-inch MacBook Air has an 8-core GPU. Step up to the 1TB model and Apple’s specs show you get the full 10-core GPU along with double the storage. So for $300 more than the $1,099 base model, you get twice the storage and 25 percent more GPU cores.

 That GPU bump helps with photo editing, light video work and games. Storage is the bigger deal for most people, though. 512GB fills up fast once you add a photo library, and you can’t upgrade it later.
 Take 24GB for $200 more if you plan to keep this MacBook Air for five years
 At $1,599, the 24GB model costs exactly $200 more than the 16GB version with the same 1TB SSD. Apple Intelligence, local AI apps and a browser with 40 tabs all eat memory. If you keep a Mac for a long time, 24GB is the safer bet. If you mostly write, browse and stream, save the $200.
 What the 13-inch MacBook Air with M5 includes
 Apple launched this MacBook Air in March . Here’s the 1TB model:
 M5 with a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU
 16GB or 24GB of unified memory and a 1TB SSD
 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display at 500 nits
 Up to 18 hours of video streaming, by Apple’s numbers
 Two Thunderbolt 4 ports, MagSafe 3, a headphone jack and support for two external displays
 12MP Center Stage camera, a 2.7 pound body and a 40W Dynamic Power Adapter
 The base 13-inch Air is also down to $1,099 on Amazon, but only in two colors
 If you don’t need 1TB, the 16GB and 512GB model is $1,099 in silver and $1,099.99 in starlight on Amazon. That matches the B&H deal we found on October 28 , though B&H adds a 70W charger. Amazon showed one starlight unit left. Midnight and sky blue cost $1,149.
 AppleCare+ costs $215 at checkout for any 13-inch model, and returns are free for 15 days. Double-check the memory and storage on the listing before you pay, since Amazon groups every configuration on one page.
